findings.body: A Telegram document named `report[1].pdf` with caption `@Helper review this` produces `[Document: report[1].pdf] (ref) @Helper review this`. This regex stops at the filename's first `]`, leaving `.pdf] (ref) @Helper review this`, so the anchored route trigger fails and the request stays history unless another continuation rule applies. The unchanged document handler interpolates the original filename into the placeholder (`media-ingestion.ts:248–252`). New evidence beyond the caption ruling: filename brackets prevent the chosen placeholder-removal rule from reaching the caption. Extract the caption independently of filename punctuation or remove the complete known placeholder.
findings.title: Handle brackets in document names when matching caption triggers
